trigger: Activate only when torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau no longer declares the deprecated verbose parameter.
behavior: Accept and discard the upstream verbose argument, then delegate every scheduling argument and operation to the installed PyTorch implementation.
scientific_effect: none; the removed argument controlled deprecation-era logging only and does not alter learning-rate values
source_treatment: The checksum-locked TabDiff source remains unchanged. The bridge is installed in the isolated model subprocess before importing the official trainer.

windows_process_environment.purpose: Allow the unchanged upstream SDMetrics diagnostics to print Unicode status marks on Windows without changing scientific outputs.

validation_requirements: The bridge must remain inactive when the installed PyTorch API still accepts verbose.
The bridge must forward all non-verbose arguments unchanged.
Windows GPU execution must retain the observed PyTorch and CUDA identities.
